# DS-Mate for Claude Code

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm --filter @ds-mate/connector-core run publish:contract`. Do not edit here. -->

Ask Claude about your DS-Mate dropshipping account: orders, stores, products, suppliers, unlinked variants, eBay buyer messages (on a plan with messaging), the dashboard summary and AliExpress product search. You choose what Claude may do when you sign in.

At sign-in you choose "Read only" or "Read and make changes". Changes (importing a
product, linking a store variant to a supplier variant) are listed only when DS-Mate
has turned them on, and each is a preview that changes nothing, then a confirm.
Paying for or placing supplier orders, deleting stores and sending buyer messages
stay in the DS-Mate dashboard.

## What you need

A DS-Mate account with at least one connected store (<https://www.ds-mate.com>).

## Install

```text
/plugin marketplace add DS-Mate/claude-code-plugins
/plugin install ds-mate@ds-mate
```

The first time a DS-Mate tool runs, Claude Code opens DS-Mate's sign-in page.
To disconnect, go to DS-Mate, Settings, Connected apps, or run `/mcp`.

## What is inside

- The DS-Mate MCP server at `https://ai.ds-mate.com/mcp` (streamable-http, OAuth sign-in).
- The `dsmate-store-check` skill, which tells Claude which DS-Mate tool answers which question.

Tool reference: <https://www.ds-mate.com/ai/tools>
